notes.title: Auto Transfer Lines Are Here! – v0.8.0
notes.content:
[p][b]🛠️ Auto Transfer Line System Has Arrived! – v0.8.0[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👋
With today’s update, a brand-new system is now active to help automate your fuel operations:[/p][p][b]➡️ Auto Transfer Lines![/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🛢️ What is this system?[/b]
From now on, you’ll be able to use a special transfer line in each Drill Zone to deliver crude oil directly to your [b]Central Underground Tank[/b]  without having to transport it manually![/p][p]Each zone has been equipped with a [b]dedicated valve[/b]. When opened, any fuel stored in [b]hose-based pumpjack systems[/b] is automatically transferred via pipeline to the center.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/a617b713f93d8a51f9b859dfe4081477aea517e5.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]⚙️ How does it work?[/b]
• First, the system must be [b]purchased via the tablet[/b].
• Then, you can [b]interact with the valve in the zone[/b] or [b]toggle its status through the app[/b].
• Only [b]hose-based pumpjacks[/b] are supported – [b]barrel-based systems are not compatible[/b].
• To activate the system, you must also own the [b]Central Crude Oil Underground Tank[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/e625af8b9c3436cd47d320088201803ca973b05f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]💰 Pricing[/b]
Since Auto Transfer Lines greatly boost speed and automation, the price is [b]balanced to reflect its value[/b].
It may be a significant investment at first, but the [b]time-saving and efficiency it provides[/b] will pay off in the long run![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all your support. We hope this feature makes your fuel empire even smoother to run! 🚀
[b]See you in the next update![/b] ❤️[/p]

tags.feature: With today’s update, a brand-new system is now active to help automate your fuel operations:➡️ Auto Transfer Lines!
From now on, you’ll be able to use a special transfer line in each Drill Zone to deliver crude oil directly to your Central Underground Tank  without having to transport it manually!
Each zone has been equipped with a dedicated valve. When opened, any fuel stored in hose-based pumpjack systems is automatically transferred via pipeline to the center.
First, the system must be purchased via the tablet.
Then, you can interact with the valve in the zone or toggle its status through the app.
Only hose-based pumpjacks are supported – barrel-based systems are not compatible.
To activate the system, you must also own the Central Crude Oil Underground Tank.

notes.title: Wall Paint & Vehicle Save System v0.7.0
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! 👋💙

Thanks to your feedback and support, we’re making the game better step by step.
This update brings new personalization features and key improvements to the vehicle system. Here’s what’s new in v0.7.0:[/b]

[h1]🚛 New Truck and Tanker[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A new Semi-Truck has been added to the game.[/b]
[i]A new vehicle option is now available for players looking to expand their fleet.[/i]
[*] [b]A new Crude Oil Tanker is now available.[/b]
[i]Having two crude oil tankers will make operations easier.[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/e4fb61d8928c853689890ed450e5ee4f42e7e773.png[/img]

[h1]🎨 Personalization: Wall Paint System[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]You can now customize your warehouse walls![/b]
[i]With the Wall Paint app, you can apply any graffiti to a total of 8 exterior wall sections.[/i]
[*] [b]Wall ordering:[/b]
[i]Sections 1–4 cover the right wall from front to back, and 5–8 cover the left wall from front to back.[/i]
[*] [b]Graffiti selection and editing:[/b]
[i]Once purchased, you can freely change your wall designs anytime. All graffiti is managed through the Wall Paint app.[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/38351421751a8f6216b9180d0053cf65afa86466.png[/img]

[h1]🔧 Vehicle System Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Vehicle positions are now saved.[/b]
[i]When you exit the game, all vehicles will be restored to their exact position and rotation.[/i]
[*] [b]A new “Reset Vehicle” button has been added.[/b]
[i]If your vehicle gets stuck or becomes unusable, you can safely teleport it back to its starting position with this button.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]⚙️ New Setting: Camera Behavior[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A Camera Auto-Center toggle has been added to the settings.[/b]
[i]Players who prefer to manually control the camera can now disable automatic alignment from the settings menu.[/i]
[/list]

[b]This update aims to offer a more personal, smoother, and more controlled gameplay experience.
We’ve brought the game to this point together with you. Every message and suggestion means a lot to us. 🙌[/b]

[h2][b]Enjoy the game and have fun! 💙[/b][/h2]

notes.title: First-Person Driving Camera + Balance Update v0.6.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋❤️

With today’s update, we’re excited to bring you the long-awaited first-person driving camera, along with major changes in production and economy balancing.

[h2]🎥 First-Person Driving Camera is Here![/h2]
It’s time to really take the wheel!
You can now switch to first-person view inside vehicles and experience a fully immersive driving perspective:

[list]
[*] Authentic cockpit view
[*] Interactive driving with left-right look support
[*] Instantly switch back to external view with a single key
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/5d27c0ec0b40e391ab427f812c5e6bbecdb148b4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/cafcfbe1600dff3cfcab87cb58ecd77efaf9bb55.gif[/img]

[h2]⚙️ Advanced Pumpjack Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased extraction speed: The advanced pump now operates significantly faster. You’ll be able to extract more oil in less time.
[*] Increased storage capacity: The advanced pumpjack now has higher capacity, allowing it to store more oil while you’re away.
[/list]

[h2]🌍 Zone Yield & Economy Balancing[/h2]
Zone 5 and Zone 6 now offer increased yield: You’ll now have a much higher chance of finding more oil from a single source in these regions.

[list]
[*] Rental prices updated: Alongside the increased value, the rental cost for Zones 5 and 6 has been raised.
[*] Economy overhaul in progress: We’ve begun a full rework of the game’s economy to make trading, inventory management, and contracts more meaningful and strategic.
[/list]

[h2]🧭 What’s Coming in the Next Update?[/h2]
[list]
[*] New truck and tanker purchasing system
[*] Vehicle save system (Now that major issues are resolved, we’ve begun active work on this feature)
[*] Improved warehouse wall visuals. Each wall will be customizable with graffiti for a more stylish and personal look
[/list]

[h3]💬 Developer Note[/h3]
[i]We’ve received a lot of feedback lately about workers in single player mode.
We’re actively developing a system that will work in both single player and co-op modes, but it’s not ready for release just yet.
We want to avoid introducing any unstable or unbalanced features, so we’re testing thoroughly.
While this feature won’t be part of the next update, it won’t be too long before it makes its way into the game.
Thank you for your patience and support. ❤️[/i]

🙏 Thanks to your interest, feedback, and continued support, we’re steadily building a truly enjoyable experience together.
[b]With your help, we’re getting closer to a better game step by step. Thank you all! ❤️[/b]

notes.title: Storage and Trailer Upgrade Update – v0.5.0
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b] 👋❤️

We’ve been listening to your feedback and today, we’re introducing two major features that expand your production and logistics capabilities:

[b]Underground storage tanks and a trailer upgrade system![/b]

With this update, you’ll be able to store more, deliver more, and operate more efficiently than ever.

[h2]🛢️ Underground Fuel Storage is Here![/h2]

One of the most requested features, fuel storage, is finally in the game!
Now, a dedicated underground tank is placed in front of the Warehouse for each fuel type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/7ee4b3c5bad827bbf77c65a2fc7125b81a745c87.jpg[/img]

With this system:

[list]
[*] You can safely store excess fuel instead of wasting it,
[*] Better manage the gap between production and delivery,
[*] Expand your storage capacity over time for more strategic gameplay.
[/list]

📱 You can purchase and upgrade these tanks through the brand-new [b]"Underground Tank"[/b] app on your tablet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/20c1e3389a1cf0525a0c5d9ab3a2e353ac26f9a8.jpg[/img]

[h2]🚚 Trailer Upgrade System Added![/h2]
Another frequent request: trailer capacity upgrades.
Now, each trailer can be individually upgraded to carry more fuel!

With the new [b]"Trailer Upgrade"[/b] app, you can:

[list]
[*] Increase each trailer’s fuel capacity,
[*] Deliver larger wholesale orders in a single trip,
[*] Boost your entire logistics flow with smarter trailer usage.
[*] No more limitations. Your fleet just got a serious upgrade!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/c5c39fd528fbcbc1d2b8805b4a74eaadcc7ad131.jpg[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]✅ Fixed a bug where two different fuel types could appear from the same oil source.[/b]
[i]This fix also resolves several related issues caused by that behavior.[/i]

[*] [b]✅ Fixed an issue where Zone 6 would sometimes only spawn 5 oil sources.[/b]
[i]Now Zone 6 will always generate the correct 6 oil sources as intended.[/i]

[*] [b]✅ Optimized performance issues caused by having too many hoses active at once.[/b]
[i]The game now runs smoother and more stable during high-traffic operations.[/i]
[/list]

 We’re incredibly excited to keep growing this game together with you.
Your feedback continues to shape development, and we’re always working to deliver better systems, deeper mechanics, and smoother experiences.

[b]Thanks for your amazing support and happy fuel harvesting![/b] 🚀❤️

notes.title: WHOLESALE UPDATE v0.4.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋❤️‍🔥

Today, we’re thrilled to introduce a brand new feature we’ve been working on for a while:

[b]The Wholesale System is now live![/b]

From now on, you won’t just be selling fuel to local stations, you’ll also be exporting it to [b]major fuel corporations across the globe![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/78a985895a0e5d89d9ee66803094277d0413b2d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/3ba108691af0c486525f7f3004da1b7d5c45bd1b.png[/img]

🌐 [b]What Are Wholesale Orders?[/b]

With the new system:

[list]
[*] You can now receive large-scale fuel orders from different countries

[*] Each order varies in [b]fuel type, quantity, and reward value[/b]

[*] Delivering quickly earns you an extra bonus (up to 60%)!]

[*] You can choose between multiple contract offers to make strategic decisions

[*] All operations are managed through the specially designed [b]Global Trade Depot[/b]

[*] 📱 [b]You can select wholesale orders from the Tablet[/b]

[*] 🗺️ [b]You can also see the Global Trade Depot’s location directly on the map[/b]
[/list]

🛠️ [b]Global Trade Depot[/b]
A brand-new logistics facility has been added to the map for wholesale trading:

[list]
[*] A high-capacity distribution center
[/list]

(📝 Note: This is not a regular storage depot  it acts only as a transfer facility.)

⏳ [b]Early Delivery = Big Profit[/b]
Every wholesale order comes with an early delivery time limit. If you're quick:

[list]
[*] Deliver fast → Earn up to 60% extra bonus!

[*] Take too long → You'll still get the base reward, but no bonus
[/list]

[h3]💡TIP
"If you secure enough crude oil before accepting a wholesale order, it will be much easier to deliver within the bonus time!"
[/h3]

✅ [b]Additional Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Tablet screen now zooms in based on your camera’s FOV
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Thank you so much for your continued support.[/b]❤️‍🔥

Let’s keep building this game together! ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: 🛢️ DEVLOG:The Wholesale System is Coming Soon! 🛢️
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

We've been working hard on something that will expand the game features and offer exciting new opportunities for all players:

[b]The Wholesale System![/b]

🚚 [b]What is the Wholesale System?[/b]
With the new Wholesale feature, you’ll be able to receive large-scale fuel orders from all around the world! 🌎
Each order will include different types of fuel (Gasoline, Octane+, Diesel, Diesel Ultra), and every shipment will come with:

[list]
[*] A base reward based on the quantity and fuel prices,

[*] An early delivery bonus depending on how quickly you can fulfill the order,
 
[*] And unique fuel company contracts created specifically for this system!
 
[*] You'll be able to choose one contract from several offers coming from different parts of the world.
[/list]

⏳[b] Early Delivery Matters![/b]
Every order will have an early delivery time limit.
If you complete the shipment quickly, you’ll earn a bonus! 🏁

[list]
[*] Deliver fast → Earn up to 60% extra bonus!

[*] Take too long → You'll still get the base reward, but no bonus.
[/list]

This creates a dynamic and exciting challenge that will push your skills even further.

🛠️[b] The New Facility[/b]
To support wholesale operations, we've added a brand new logistics facility to the game:

[list]
[*] Massive fuel storage tanks,

[*] A distribution center specifically designed for bulk deliveries!
[/list]

(You can check out some early sneak peek screenshots below!) 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/78a985895a0e5d89d9ee66803094277d0413b2d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/5bdbc26599ed43f6c4499445ac92c199b9578f86.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/3ba108691af0c486525f7f3004da1b7d5c45bd1b.png[/img]


📅 [b]When is it coming?[/b]
We’re currently polishing the final details and testing everything to ensure it’s smooth and fun! 🎮
If everything goes according to plan, the Wholesale Update will be released within the next few days!

We are incredibly excited to share this new feature with you!
Thank you so much for your patience and continuous support. ❤️
We’re almost there and we can't wait to see your mega fuel empire grow even bigger! 🚀

notes.title: Update Notes Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ❤️

With this update, we've improved many visual, feel, and smoothness issues that directly affect the gameplay experience. 🙏

We’re truly grateful for all the small but important details you've shared with us while playing! 💬

Every day, together with you, we’re making the game more enjoyable and smoother. 🌾🎮

[b]Here’s what’s new and improved with version 0.3.0:[/b]

[list]
[*] 🛠️ The placement system has been almost completely rebuilt! Those annoying placement issues that disrupted the experience have been largely eliminated.
[*] 🚛 Passenger seat functionality has been added to trucks! You can now ride together with your friend in Co-op mode. 🤝
[*] 🛬 Fixed an issue where a friend would float in the air after getting into a vehicle in Co-op mode!
[*] 🔄 Pickup trucks, trailers, and big trucks now automatically recover when flipped over no more getting stuck on the road! 🚗✨
[*] 🔄 Palletjacks now also auto-recover when flipped upside down, saving you from frustrating resets! 🛒
[*] 🔤 Fixed the square font issue that appeared in some languages. You'll now see clean and correct text across all supported languages! 🌍
[*] ⚙️ General improvements have been made to the physics system for smoother driving, more natural movements, and better responsiveness! 🌟
[*] 🛢️ Fixed rare issues when connecting hoses to the Pumpjack, making connections safer and more stable. 🛠️
[*] ⛽ Selling fuel with tankers now grants you level (XP) progression! 📈
[*] 🛠️ Minor bug fixes to further improve overall stability.
[*] ⚙️ Small optimizations were made to enhance performance and reduce minor hitches.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/f45fff37cc9202718f6e9894fab6e6d577426ed8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/868789f6621903a1d3abf8e35108389cacf94495.gif[/img]

💖 [b]Thank you so much for always standing by our side![/b] 💖
[b]It’s a true joy to walk this journey together with all of you! [/b]🚜✨

notes.title: Update- Cashier System & Improvements – v0.2.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! ❤️

The 0.2.0 update is here, bringing brand new features and improvements to the world of Fuel Harvest Together. Here's what's new:

🧑‍💼 [b]Cashier System Added[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now hire a cashier in both singleplayer and multiplayer modes for a daily salary.
[*] The first payment is made when you hire them, and after that, their salary is automatically deducted every day at 6:00 PM.
[*] If you can’t pay their salary, the cashier will leave the job. 😢
[*] While a cashier is active, you can't manually scan products, but you can control their shifts from the tablet. 📱
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/0e1ded0dcd3435a9015075d4e7bf266d6c406e28.jpg[/img]

📋 [b]New Employees Menu[/b]

[list]
[*] A new "Employees" menu has been added to the tablet.
[*] In future updates, all new hireable workers will be managed here, along with their shift status.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/beaffa836c9811da41676d0721dee1957b64f445.jpg[/img]

⛽ [b]Fuel Transfer and Silo Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Fuel transfer speed through hoses has been increased 4x! 🚀
[*] Hoses will now stay connected to their point unless you manually detach them.
[*] The processing speed of large silos has been increased 4x.
[*] Large conversion silos now have a crude oil and target fuel capacity of 250 liters. 🛢️
[/list]

🛢️ [b]Barrel Delivery Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] When delivering fuel to gas stations using barrels, the UI will no longer make you wait.
[*] It will now simply act as an indicator while you continue working smoothly.
[/list]

🔧 [b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor bug fixes. 🐛
[*] Some small optimizations were made. ⚙️
[/list]

[b]Thank you so much for all your feedback and support![/b] ❤️

notes.title: Update & Patch Notes – Version 0.1.8
notes.content:
Hey everyone ❤️

Our new update is live! With this version, we’ve implemented many suggestions from the community. As we continue our Early Access journey, we're shaping Fuel Harvest Together based on your feedback.

Here's what's new in [b]v0.1.8[/b]:

🛢️ [b]Fuel Station Orders Now Scale with Level[/b]
[list]
[*] Fuel stations now place larger orders as your level increases. The higher your level, the more fuel they will request.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/a21fc5449e424ae25ea19572f89e865de6a7c834.png[/img]

🚚 [b]Pickup Truck Capacity and Price Updates[/b]

All pickup trucks have received updated capacities and prices:

[list]
[*] Grey Pickup: 9 barrel capacity (Free)
[*] Red Pickup: 18 barrel capacity ($2000)
[*] Black Pickup: 18 barrel capacity ($4000)
[*] Blue Pickup: 27 barrel capacity ($5000)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/6a37713d2c561e4a135a9b6670eab5faf5a11af0.png[/img]

🗺️ [b]View Order Details on the Map[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now see how much of each fuel type has been ordered and delivered directly on the map for each station.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/46df22c4323852167d71977645fe0a21146da851.png[/img]

🔧 [b]General Improvements and Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug where pickup trucks appeared damaged after loading a saved game
[*] You can now place products on shelves even if a customer is approaching them
[*] Fixed an issue where some shelves wouldn’t accept products despite having space
[*] Resolved a bug where shelves skipped the middle slot and only filled the sides
[*] Various small bug fixes and optimizations
[*] Adjusted the in-game economy to better reflect the new order and delivery system
[/list]

🔜 [b]Coming Soon[/b]
We’re currently working on the next big features:

[list]
[*] Cashier system
[*] Wholesale contract mechanics for expanded business opportunities
[/list]

These features are actively in development and will be coming soon!

[b]Note:[/b]

Thanks again for your continued support! ❤️

notes.title: Major Bug Fixes and What's Next?
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3]

[b]It's been exactly 3 days since we launched our Early Access journey.
First of all, we would like to sincerely thank all players who shared their feedback and bug reports with us through Discord, QQ, and Steam Discussions during this important period.[/b]

[b]Even though we conducted extensive testing before launch, thanks to your support, we were able to quickly detect and fix issues that emerged with real player traffic.[/b]
[b][h3]We sincerely apologize to players who experienced data loss or serious problems. Your patience and understanding mean a lot to us. ❤️[/h3][/b]

[h3]Here's a summary of what we've fixed over these past 3 days through important patches:[/h3]

[h3]🛠️ Patch Notes Summary:[/h3]

[h2]Version 0.0.2[/h2] [list] [*] Fixed customer movement issues. [*] Added the [Optimize Liquid Physics] option to address FPS drops and crash issues during oil extraction. [*] Fixed an issue where pumpjacks could not be destroyed. [*] Added an exit button to the Store Customization screen. [*] Small performance improvements were made. [*] Various minor bug fixes. [*] Minor UI adjustments. [/list]

[h2]Version 0.0.3[/h2] [list] [*] Fixed the data loss issue that caused players to revert to Level 1 and $100. [*] Fixed the black screen issue when launching the game in Offline Mode. [*] Fixed the issue where products would disappear in the store. [*] Reduced sun brightness. [*] UI improvements. [*] Minor bug fixes. [/list]

[h2]Version 0.0.4[/h2] [list] [*] Added an "Unstuck" (Flip Vehicle) option to the pause menu for trucks and tankers. [*] Fixed an issue where saved games could not be loaded in Single Player mode. [*] Increased trailer capacity to 3000. [*] Disabled collision issues on cactuses. [*] Various minor bug fixes. [/list]

[h2]Version 0.0.5[/h2] [list] [*] Fixed an issue where "ESC" and "TAB" keys would not work after establishing a hose connection. [*] Fixed an issue where hoses could not be picked up again after placement in Single Player mode. [/list]

[h2]Version 0.0.6[/h2] [list] [*] Fixed barrel and machine issues in Multiplayer mode. [*] Fixed save data loss caused by these Multiplayer issues. [*] Fixed an error when deleting pumpjacks. [*] Fixed an error when throwing crates into the trash. [/list]

[h2][b]📢 What's Next?[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Adding an item selling system. [*] Increasing gas station orders based on player level. [*] Adding silos for storing large quantities of oil. [*] Creating wholesale contract systems and bulk sales mechanics. [*] Improving worker systems, especially for Single Player mode (with additional improvements for Multiplayer as well). [*] Developing an advanced sound system (enhancing environment and interaction sounds). [*] Expanding the store garage area. [*] Developing an improved customer system. [/list]

[b]And of course, we will continue working on many new mechanics based on your feedback and suggestions![/b]

[b]We are shaping Fuel Harvest Together together.
Thank you once again to all players who have supported us with their constructive feedback. ❤️ [/b]

notes.title: DEVLOG #4
notes.content:
Hey everyone, <3 

First off, thanks a lot for showing interest in our game. We’ve been reading all your feedback and suggestions carefully, and they really help us shape the direction of development.

As you know, the demo doesn’t have a time limit instead, we added a production limit. This way, we aimed to give you the longest possible playtime in the free version. With the latest demo patch, we’ve made a few improvements:

Some performance optimizations,

Fixed a bunch of minor bugs,

Made some small economy adjustments,

And we also removed unnecessary rocks and plants in front of the shop,that area should feel a lot cleaner now.

What we’re working on now:
We’re improving the tanker system, making it more efficient and worthwhile compared to the barrel.

We’re also adding an achievement system to the game! If you have any creative or fun ideas for achievements, feel free to send them our way; we’d love to include some of your suggestions.

Thanks again for sharing your thoughts and ideas with us. It genuinely helps, and we appreciate being able to build this together with you.

More patch & updates coming soon, stay tuned!
